profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. describes itself as a leading global autonomous driving technology company. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, it says it is developing autonomous driving technology and has accumulated millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing. The company positions its core "virtual driver" technology across three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). Its website states that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it holds licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations worldwide.

Pony AI Inc. is a for-profit public company with ticker PONY and SEC CIK 0001969302, headquartered in Guangzhou. The company says it aims to bring safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility, and that it is commercializing autonomous driving across robotaxi, robotruck, and personally owned vehicle segments.
